groups.problem: FallbackLocaleList#[] calls SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym without a nil guard, so a nil default_locale raises NoMethodError.
groups.rationale: Both point to the same missing nil guard before .to_sym on the same lines, and both propose the same safe-navigation fix.

groups.problem: translate only loads the current locale, so fallback locales stay unloaded outside of ApplicationController#set_locale (jobs, mailers, console).
groups.rationale: Both report the same gap: the fallback chain is only preloaded during requests. Both propose making translate load the whole fallback chain.

problems: SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym has no nil guard, so it can raise NoMethodError.
The locale is not converted to a Symbol, so a String/Symbol mix makes uniq ineffective and causes repeated reloads.
uncoveredProblems: The locale is not converted to a Symbol, so a String/Symbol mix makes uniq ineffective and causes duplicate loads and reloads.
